title: arundinella peruviana
intro: Arundinella peruviana, commonly known as Peruvian grass, is a type of plant species belonging to the family Poaceae. It is valued for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health conditions. The plant has been traditionally used to treat fever, inflammation, and respiratory issues due to its therapeutic actions, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antipyretic properties. The bioactive constituents of Arundinella peruviana include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its health benefits and medicinal uses.
